guide.device:
1. Restart the device completely (hold power, choose Restart).
2. Close all tabs and reopen LOG.
3. If the screen freezes, try another browser (Chrome or Firefox).
4. Still stuck? Ask your teacher for a shared device.
guide.connectivity:
1. Check that Wi-Fi is switched on.
2. Move closer to the router / access point.
3. Restart the router: unplug for 30 seconds, plug back in.
4. LOG works offline too — your saved work syncs when the connection returns.
guide.account:
1. Your password needs at least 6 characters.
2. Use the "Forgot password" link on the login page.
3. A teacher can reset your password at school.
guide.content:
1. Lessons that show "Needs practice" can be repeated — that's normal and good!
2. Close and reopen the lesson once.
3. If the same lesson still fails, tell your teacher which one.
guide.other: Describe what happened in your own words below — the more detail, the faster your teacher can help.
